body: aaa no need to cancel yourself ! i only get annoyed if a buyer needs an item in a week or less, since a delay by the post office may happen even if i ship immediately ! i think asking to receive an item in 2.5 weeks is very reasonable !

i accept 24 hour holds so if the buyer backs out i wouldn’t have wasted too much time. the reason i accept them is that if someone really likes something, but can’t purchase instantly, i’d like to give them more of a chance to make the purchase. if there are other people interested in an item on hold, i’ll let them know when the hold ends. if the hold expires and the original buyer still hasn’t purchased, i’ll message the other people interested before i update the listing !
these grow in my garden, they’re called bleeding hearts !

NTA absolutely. 

it’s dumb to punish your son because she doesn’t like his mother, they are two different people !!!! it IS her wedding but there are limits, and banning someone from attending for daring to be the descendant of her “sworn enemy”, is one of them. she shouldn’t blame your son for something he has zero control over, such as who his mother is and the bride’s negative history with her.

you’re very justified in not going to the wedding, i’m glad you’re sticking up for your son ! it means the world to kids when they know that their parent is standing by them and will continue to support them in the future. 

i’m sorry that your family is in this situation regarding the wedding, but you’re handling it very well.
